description: Bitcoin fee rates for confirmation targets, plus the mempool floor. When to use: pricing a Bitcoin transaction, or deciding when a sweep will confirm cheaply. Do not use: to measure backlog depth (that is btc_get_mempool_state). There is no equivalent for Zcash: ZEC fees are protocol-fixed, see robotbase_capabilities. Returns: estimates for 1/2/3/6/12/24-block targets in BTC/kvB, recommended.fast_1_block_sat_vb / medium_3_block_sat_vb / slow_12_block_sat_vb, mempool_min_sat_vb.
name: btc_get_fee_rates
